text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon has been improving her skills greatly
and steadily racking up achievements lately.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Kyururunâ
All right, onto the next song~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even at solo concerts, crowds began to gather and the excitement truly picked up.

text_block_list.name: Concertgoer A
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... That really felt like a dream~.

text_block_list.name: Concertgoer B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though. If I sleep, I just have to go back to work~.
Ugh, such a drag...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was fun☆
Good work today, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What's wrong?
choice_data_list: Ah, no. It's nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Lately, the crowds have been growing
for both the races and the concerts, haven't they!
choice_data_list: I think you're working really hard.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If we keep hyping things up like this,
I'm sure...—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
Trainer, you've noticed too, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's the same for the Winning Live.
Right now, Falco is able to "entertain"
the people who come to watch—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still... as for whether I'm really giving everyone
the energy to do their best tomorrow...
I'm just—not confident.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Being able to do that is what makes a true Umadol.
...Just like Haiseiko-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Uuuuughhhhh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is deep in thought.
It seems Haiseiko is constantly
on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Then I might as well.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? We can go to
Haiseiko-san's live!?
choice_data_list: Only if you're okay with it, of course.
If you're okay with it, that is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll go, I'll go! Of course I'm going!
I'm a huge fan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaa~! HAI-SEI-KO-!
HAI-SEI-KO-!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for coming today~~!
It's hot out, so make sure to stay hydrated!
Let's get hyped together!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"‘We're good~!’ ‘All ready to go!’
‘We'll cheer as loud as you want~!’"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Don't mind if I do—
I'll gladly take all of everyone's cheers for myself!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's Haiseiko is here today too!
Come and take a look~!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was amazing~☆
Haiseiko-san really is in a league of her own.
choice_data_list: Did that give you a hint?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, it's hard to put into words, but...
I think I'm starting to get it, just a little.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I watched her on TV long ago,
Haiseiko-san has always been shining so bright—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"She was the kind of Umadol who always made me think,
'I want to be just like that!'"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even now, after retiring from racing—
that hasn't changed at all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. Even though I was worrying about it for so long—
wondering what I could do to cheer everyone up.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I feel like I can see the goal clearly once again.
What Haiseiko-san has always been showing me
all this time.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...And so! All of my worries turned into the feeling of 'I'm gonna do my best!'"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To deliver "Fight, Oh☆" to everyone...
first, we gotta give "Fight, Oh☆" to Falco and the others!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing the figure she admires, Smart Falcon seemed to cast aside her doubts. She renewed her determination to do her best working as a team once more.
